entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A young beast of unknown species and time, found in stasis in Maag Taranau, who can locate and navigate Omenpaths and holds a map of the Multiverse in his mind.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who finds Loot in stasis and uses him for his plan, later dying in the Meditation Plane.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon who cares for Loot alongside Jace and later raises him on Vryn.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: The vault on Thunder Junction where Loot was sealed in suspended animation.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The plane where Maag Taranau is located.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A figure who sent Jace to investigate Maag Taranau around 4554 AR.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon whose fear Tezzeret wanted Jace to find in the vault.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A scholar who told Jace about the creature in the vault from a scroll.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A planeswalker who approached the pod in Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: The identity Jace wears as a disguise at the vault.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Jace meets in Duskmourn.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The demon of Duskmourn who captured Loot.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: Captain of the Speed Demons who caged Loot atop his vehicle, the Last Ride.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Cloudspire Racing Team who dislikes Winter's treatment of Loot and helps rescue him.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A character who helps rescue Loot from the Saurid raiders.

entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: A goblin who befriends Loot while awaiting sacrifice.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A planeswalker who picks Loot up as the survivors escape the Meditation Plane.

entities.name: Ranna Beleren
entities.description: Jace's mother, who acts as a parental figure for Loot on Vryn.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A gorgon who arrives at the Beleren household seeking Vraska's help.

entities.name: Speed Demons
entities.description: A racing team that conscripts Loot as a navigation aide.

entities.name: Saurid raiders
entities.description: Raiders on Muraganda who captured Loot.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: The parallel Multiverse Jace created after the Meditation Realm disaster.

entities.name: Meditation Plane
entities.description: The plane where Jace cast his spell to recreate the Multiverse.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths between planes that Loot can locate and navigate.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A plane where Loot wandered through a moth-covered door.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Jace's home plane where Vraska and Ranna raise Loot.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane where Jace, Vraska and Loot rest.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: The interplanar race in which Loot was used as a navigation aide.

events.summary: Around 4554 AR Tezzeret sends Jace to Thunder Junction to investigate Maag Taranau; Jace senses a slumbering childlike mind but cannot get in.
events.quote: Jace detected a slumbering, childlike mind deep within the vault, but could not get in.

events.summary: Months after the War of the Spark, Jace asks Tamiyo about the vault, and she tells him about the creature inside.
events.quote: Jace asked Tamiyo about the vault.

events.summary: Oko approaches the pod in Maag Taranau and notices a shape moving behind the glass.
events.quote: When the planeswalker Oko approached the pod, he noticed a shape moving behind the glass

events.summary: Jace, disguised as Ashiok, shatters the pod and frees Loot, then disappears with Loot and Vraska.
events.quote: He pressed both hands to the glass, and the pod shattered.

events.summary: Jace and Vraska use Loot's mental map to plot a course across the Multiverse, stopping at Bloomburrow among other places.
events.quote: With his mental map, they plotted a course across the Multiverse and left Thunder Junction with Loot in tow.

events.summary: Loot wanders through a moth-covered door into Duskmourn; Jace and Vraska are separated and Jace travels briefly with Kaito Shizuki.
events.quote: Jace and Vraska followed him to Duskmourn where they quickly became separated.

events.summary: Valgavoth captures Loot, who is conscripted onto the Speed Demons and caged by captain Winter atop the Last Ride.
events.quote: Although Jace went after his family, the demon Valgavoth captured Loot.

events.summary: Saurid raiders capture Loot on Muraganda; he befriends Daretti and Chandra and Pia Nalaar rescue them.
events.quote: While they were waiting to be sacrificed, he befriended the goblin Daretti .

events.summary: Back on Avishkar, Jace demands his child back, mind-controls racers, knocks out those who resist and takes Loot, leaving with Vraska for Tarkir.
events.quote: Though they attempted to fight back, Jace rendered them unconscious, taking Loot back.

events.summary: On Tarkir Vraska notices Loot trying to hide from Jace and tries to dissuade him from keeping Loot in stasis.
events.quote: Vraska noted that Loot kept trying to hide from the mind mage

events.summary: Jace's spell in the Meditation Plane fails and unmakes reality including Jace; Narset picks up Loot as the survivors escape, and he is returned to the grieving Vraska on Tarkir.
events.quote: The distressed Loot was picked up by Narset right before the survivors escaped.

events.summary: On Vryn, Vraska and Ranna raise Loot and give him a basic education.
events.quote: On Vryn, Vraska and Jace's mother Ranna acted as parental figures for Loot, giving him a basic education.

events.summary: Vraska uses Loot's talents to map a way to the Echoverse from Vryn but does not bring him along.
events.quote: she used Loot's talents to map a way there from Vryn, but did not bring him along

relations.quote: Jace and his collaborator Vraska disappeared with Loot.
Vraska and Jace's mother Ranna acted as parental figures for Loot
The team's captain, Winter , caged Loot on top of his vehicle, the Last Ride .
At some point, Loot was sealed in suspended animation inside Maag Taranau .
